title: Pure G Golem
summary: An EARTH Cyberse co-linking strategy built around G Golem Pebble Dog, Rock Hammer, and Gravity Balance, supported by generic EARTH Cyberse extenders. The deck climbs through G Golem Stubborn Menhir and G Golem Crystal Heart to establish a co-linked wall of G Golem Invalid Dolmen and Dignified Trilithon.

summary.title: Starters
points: G Golem Pebble Dog searches another copy of itself when Normal or Special Summoned, and searches any G Golem card when sent from the hand to the GY.
Cynet Mining discards G Golem Pebble Dog to search Widget Kid or Dotscaper, triggering Pebble Dog at the same time to search Gravity Balance or G Golem Rock Hammer.
Lady Debug searches Pebble Dog, Widget Kid, or Dotscaper on summon, while Foolish Burial dumps Dotscaper for an immediate EARTH Cyberse body on the field.

summary.title: Opening: Cynet Mining + G Golem Pebble Dog
steps: Activate Cynet Mining, discarding G Golem Pebble Dog to search Widget Kid; Pebble Dog triggers in the GY to search Gravity Balance (or another Pebble Dog).
Normal Summon Widget Kid and Special Summon the second Pebble Dog from the hand, which searches the third Pebble Dog.
Link Summon G Golem Stubborn Menhir using Widget Kid and Pebble Dog, then use Menhir and another Cyberse extender (like Dotscaper) to Link Summon G Golem Crystal Heart.
Use Crystal Heart to revive Stubborn Menhir to its linked zone; Menhir triggers on revival from the GY to Special Summon an EARTH monster from the GY, setting up co-linked Link-3 bosses.

summary.title: Token Swarm & Gravity Balance
summary.text: G Golem Rock Hammer discards itself from the hand to reduce a G Golem's Level by 2 so it can be Normal Summoned without Tributing, or tributes itself on the field to Special Summon 3 EARTH Cyberse G Golem Tokens in Defense Position (locking you to Cyberse monsters for the turn). Gravity Balance banishes 2 EARTH monsters from your field or GY (triggering Dotscaper's banish revival) to revive two 0 ATK/DEF G Golem monsters (Pebble Dog) from the GY, and later banishes itself from the GY to save a G Golem from battle or effect destruction.

summary.title: Co-Linked Bosses
points: G Golem Invalid Dolmen makes all co-linked monsters you control unaffected by monster effects activated on the opponent's field, forces the opponent to attack it first, and discards a Cyberse to draw 1 card.

G Golem Dignified Trilithon forces attacks onto itself, sends an EARTH monster from the hand to the GY to negate an attacking monster's effects and halve its ATK, and negates opponent effects that target your Link Monsters.
G Golem Crystal Heart revives an EARTH Link Monster to its arrow and places counters that grant co-linked EARTH monsters a second attack and piercing damage.
Transcode Talker revives Stubborn Menhir or Crystal Heart to a co-linked zone, giving both targeting protection and 500 ATK, while Update Jammer and Accesscode Talker close the game.

allow.Cynet Mining: Discards G Golem Pebble Dog (triggering its hand-to-GY search effect) to search another Level 4 or lower Cyberse starter.
allow.Dotscaper: Level 1 EARTH Cyberse that Special Summons itself when sent to the GY or banished (synergizing with Gravity Balance), providing the EARTH material required for G Golem Stubborn Menhir.
allow.Widget Kid: Level 3 EARTH Cyberse that Special Summons a Cyberse monster from hand, satisfying both EARTH and Cyberse Link requirements.
allow.Lady Debug: Level 4 Cyberse starter that searches G Golem Pebble Dog, Widget Kid, or Dotscaper on Normal or Special Summon.
allow.Foolish Burial: Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Dotscaper or G Golem Pebble Dog to the GY to extend EARTH Cyberse Link plays.
allow.Transcode Talker: Link-3 EARTH Cyberse that revives a Link-3 or lower Cyberse to a co-linked zone, satisfying G Golem Invalid Dolmen's co-link requirement and EARTH Attribute.
allow.Update Jammer: Link-2 WIND Cyberse that allows a Link Monster summoned using it as material to attack twice during each Battle Phase.
allow.Accesscode Talker: Link-4 DARK Cyberse finisher that gains massive ATK and banishes Link Monsters from GY to destroy multiple cards without allowing responses.
allow.Gouki Sheik Ogre: Gouki Sheik Ogre: Endboard boss featured on page analysis.
